claims.claim_text: Date of Incident: August 30, 2023
Time of Incident: Approximately 2136 hours
Location: Old Ranch Condominium, 3600 block of Aster Street, Seal Beach, CA
Reporting Officer: Officer K. Thornton
Badge Number: 7234
Corporal Estrada and I were dispatched to a residence in the Old Ranch Condominium development
a male subject attempting to kick down the caller's front door
The caller described the male as wearing a jacket, mask, beanie, and dark brown work boots
I arrived at approximately 2140 hours
I observed a male subject, later identified as the subject, peering over the brick perimeter wall of the enclosed rear patio area. Only his head was visible
I stood in the walkway approximately 40 feet east
I used my flashlight to illuminate the subject
I identified myself and commanded him to come out of the enclosed area
The subject stated he was there to see the reporting party
I informed him the reporting party had called police and did not want him there
I instructed the subject to show me his hands
He refused and told me to stop shining the flashlight on his face
At approximately 2142 hours, Corporal Estrada arrived and parked approximately 200 to 300 feet south
The subject then disappeared behind the patio wall
I drew my duty weapon
At approximately 2142 hours, the subject exited the patio area wearing a baggy black jacket, blue jeans, a black hat, and clear glasses
He had a beverage can in his right hand
I ordered the subject to put his hands up
He ignored my commands and continued walking toward me
He moved the beverage can from his right hand to his left hand
He placed his right hand into his right front jacket pocket
and turned back toward the enclosed patio
Corporal Estrada warned he would deploy a Taser
At approximately 2142 hours, Corporal Estrada deployed his Taser, striking the subject in the back
The subject fell onto his left side and then flat on his back
The subject reached toward his right-side waistband and drew what appeared to be a black Glock handgun
He pointed the weapon in the direction of Corporal Estrada
I fired my duty weapon 21 rounds
Corporal Estrada fired nine rounds from his handgun
The subject stated "Finish me off" while on his back
Officers held him at gunpoint until a third officer arrived at approximately 2148 hours
removed the gun from near the subject's right hand
and handcuffed him
OCFA Engine 84 arrived at approximately 2152 hours
The weapon was a Glock 22, .40-caliber, registered to the subject's father
Scene secured for investigation
